---
title: "Dashboard template"
description: "A dashboard: an app shell with a brand, a navigation and a user menu fixed, and a page header for each page."
---

A template renders `AppShellLayout`, fixes part of it, and exposes props for the rest. It is copy-code: the file is yours to edit.

## Preview

**Anatomy** colours the fixed parts, the props, and the scroll region. The panel changes the props live; the fixed parts stay.

<LayoutPreview slug="templates/dashboard/default" kind="template" controls={"[{\"name\":\"title\",\"label\":\"Title\",\"type\":\"text\",\"value\":\"Orders\"},{\"name\":\"description\",\"label\":\"Description\",\"type\":\"text\",\"value\":\"Every order this month.\"},{\"name\":\"activeHref\",\"label\":\"Current page\",\"type\":\"select\",\"value\":\"/orders\",\"options\":[\"/\",\"/orders\",\"/customers\",\"/settings\"]}]"} codeFiles="../../templates/dashboard/dashboard-template.tsx,examples/templates/dashboard/default.tsx" />

## Fixed and variable

**Fixed by the template** (edit the constants at the top of the file):

- Brand
- Navigation with `aria-current`
- User menu
- Navigation trigger on small screens

**Props** (the variable part):

- `title`, `description`, `breadcrumbs`, `actions`
- `activeHref`: the current page
- `children`: the page content

## Install

<RegistryCommand name="dashboard-template" />

## Code

The template is one file, and a page uses it. The page sets only what varies: no heights, no overflow.
